joinQualification.candidateConsideredOnly: Remove .ToArray() and pass Values.Select(o => o.ItemSpec) directly to string.Join.
joinQualification.baselineOverloadSourceReasoning: ToArray returns string[]. The string.Join(string?, params string?[]) overload takes it directly and delegates to span-based JoinCore.
joinQualification.candidateOverloadSourceReasoning: The projected IEnumerable<string> selects the non-generic IEnumerable<string?> Join overload. Its projected iterator is not the recognized string[] or List<string> fast-path input.
joinQualification.arrayPath: JoinCore sums string/separator lengths, creates an exactly sized result, and copies strings and separators; it special-cases a one-character separator.
joinQualification.enumerablePath: The IEnumerable overload recognizes arrays and lists, but otherwise obtains an enumerator and appends into ValueStringBuilder before producing the result string.
joinQualification.linqPath: Select.cs:45-59 recognizes an array source in the ordinary non-size-optimized path; ArraySelectIterator.ToArray at Select.SpeedOpt.cs:138-169 creates a result array of the known source length and fills it directly. ToCollection.cs:12-24 dispatches to that iterator override when applicable.
joinQualification.importantDistinction: Deleting ToArray does not delete Select's projected iterator and does not preserve the baseline's string-array join path. A single-use array is not sufficient source evidence of an improvement.

deterministicOutputContract.boundary: Source-established contract only; no GUID outputs were generated or compared at runtime.
steps: Read ItemSpec strings in Values array order.
Join with a literal comma, preserving order and duplicates.
Apply ToLowerInvariant to the complete joined string.
Parse NamespaceGuid and pass the normalized string to the existing Uuid.Create.

Uuid.Create converts the namespace's first fields to network order, encodes the name with Encoding.Unicode, hashes namespace bytes plus name bytes with SHA256, truncates to 16 bytes, applies the existing version/variant bits and constructs Guid.
GenerateGuid calls ToString and returns the Guid property to the selected MSBuild property.
deterministicOutputContract.algorithmCaveat: The code comments use UUID3/RFC terminology, but this report describes the actual existing SHA256 implementation; it does not substitute a different UUID algorithm.
materialConsumers: Wix.targets:59 appends ProductCode and UpgradeCode to DefineConstants; HostOptions\Product.wxs:3 consumes both on the WiX Package element.
Wix.targets:78 exports BundleVersion, BundleProviderKey and BundleUpgradeCode as DefineConstants; WindowsHostingBundle\Bundle.wxs:2 consumes BundleUpgradeCode.
Wix.props:22-25 explicitly warns that stable namespace GUIDs must not change.
stability: HostOptions ProductCode includes the version/revision-bearing Version; its UpgradeCode uses the major/minor band and OutputType.
Both bundle calls use the same namespace and same ordered major/minor plus platform inputs, implying the same GUID for unchanged inputs; no runtime comparison was run.
A candidate would have to preserve normalization, item order, encoding, hash construction, format and material WiX properties, not merely make a standalone Join expression return a plausible string.
